title: Bottom-heavy; difficult to place.
text: Bottom-heavy; difficult to place.. A corkscrew should be easy to mount on the cork. We have a handful of corkscrews, and this one is our least-used one. The fat bottom is very heavy and causes us to reposition the screw a few times to get it right in the middle. The sheen is nice and easy to clean, but considering it's not used that much there's not a lot of maintenance involved.

description: The zinc plated corkscrew by Capabunga brings exciting and innovative improvements to the traditional corkscrew – a common tool which has seen little evolution over the years. The corkscrew handle is made with silicone for a soft and forgiving Texture which feels great in the hand. Combined with the ergonomic shape, the handle is extremely comfortable to hold and will alleviate pain and fatigue associated with the frequent use of traditional corkscrews or wine keys. The worm is coated with Teflon which allows it to glide into the cork with greater ease and it has small grooves which act as grippers, increasing resistance within the cork, ensuring a more successful removal of any type of cork. The corkscrew has all the essential features, including a double hinged lever for easy two-step pulling, a serrated blade to cut and remove foil and the integrated bottle opener. For best results, hand wash and dry immediately. This corkscrew makes an excellent gift and will quickly become the go-to wine tool for professional waiters opening multiple bottles A night, A wine aficionado or simply someone who serves a bottle of wine at home every now and again.
